title: ENVOYS OF FOUR NATIONS PRESENT CREDENTIALS TO THE PRESIDENT OF INDIA
body_text: The President of India, Smt Droupadi Murmu accepted credentials from the envoys  of Mali, Myanmar, Madagascar and Equatorial Guinea at a ceremony held at Rashtrapati Bhavan today (November 6, 2026). Those who presented their credentials were: 1.   H.E. Mr Fatoma Thera, Ambassador of the Republic of Mali 2.   H.E. Mr U Aye Min Htwe, Ambassador of the Republic of the Union of Myanmar 3.   H.E. Mr Mandehatsara Georget, Ambassador of the Republic of Madagascar 4.   H.E. Mr Miguel Edjang Angue, Ambassador of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea **** MJPS/SS/PRK
